summary: Phase P0.3.C — Curated Collections UI (CINEMATIC VERTICAL MARKET PERSPECTIVE) thoroughly tested. Backend POST /api/references/{id}/actions endpoint + tenant isolation verified via 10 new pytest cases (all PASS). Frontend /workspace/references tested end-to-end as super_admin and studio2 (tenant isolation). All structural, linguistic, and CTA requirements met. ONE minor bug: project picker shows empty list because frontend mis-reads /api/projects response shape — link_project CTA cannot complete from UI (backend itself works fine).

ui_bugs.issue: Project picker always shows 'No active projects available. Open a project from the Workspace first.' even when tenant has projects. Root cause: in ReferencesPage.jsx line ~505, `projR.data?.projects || projR.data` returns the full response object `{data:[...], total:N}` (an object, not array) because /api/projects returns `{data: [...], total: N}`. Then Array.isArray() is false, so projects state stays []. Need to use `projR.data?.data || projR.data?.projects || []` instead.

integration_issues.issue: Primary CTA opens the picker, but since project list is empty due to the shape bug above, the user cannot pick a project and trigger link_project. Backend endpoint itself works (validated by pytest test_link_project_ok).

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/workspace/ReferencesPage.jsx line ~505 projects shape unpack: replace `const projectList = projR.data?.projects || projR.data || []` with `const projectList = projR.data?.data || projR.data?.projects || (Array.isArray(projR.data) ? projR.data : [])` so the picker renders the tenant's projects and the Add-to-Design-Direction CTA completes the link_project round trip + 'Connected to …' toast.
critical_code_review_comments: ReferencesPage.jsx is ~560 lines, single-file — borderline but acceptable given editorial cohesion; consider extracting PerspectiveSelector + AdvisorActionBar to /components/references/ if it grows.
Cinematic transition relies on setTimeout chains; works but consider useTransition / CSS view transitions for buttery feel.
Backend reference_action() correctly returns 404 on cross-tenant project_id via _row_or_404, 400 on missing project_id, 409 on processing status, 400 on unknown action — all verified.
Sonner toast.error path is wired for failures but the only end-to-end failure visible to users today is the project-picker empty state (a frontend data shape bug, no error toast).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (only project-picker empty-list bug; all linguistic / structural / cinematic checks pass)

rca_of_the_issue: Project picker empty: /api/projects in this codebase returns `{data: [...], total: N}`, but ReferencesPage hydration does `projR.data?.projects || projR.data || []` which yields the whole envelope object → Array.isArray() === false → projects state stays []. The picker renders the empty-state copy, blocking the link_project UI flow. Backend is healthy; the patch is a one-line front-end fix.
